name: Singlife Davao Marathon
short_description: The Singlife Davao Marathon is a full-marathon event taking place on August 15, 2026 in Davao City, Philippines, organized by RUNRIO Inc.
ai_summary: The Singlife Davao Marathon is a full-marathon event scheduled for August 15, 2026, in Davao City, Philippines. Organized by RUNRIO Inc., the race is based at SM City Lanang and offers four distance options: 42.195km, 21.1km, 10km, and 5km. Registration for the event is currently open, giving runners of varying experience levels a chance to participate.
pros: Multiple distance options (42.195km, 21.1km, 10km, 5km) accommodate different runner levels
Organized by RUNRIO Inc., an established race organizer
Convenient venue at SM City Lanang in Davao City
research_highlights: Inaugural edition: the race debuts in Davao on August 15, 2026, as the fifth leg of the Singlife Philippine Marathon Majors series, so no past-edition course conditions or crowd-support reports exist yet.
Course starts and finishes at SM City Lanang / SM Lanang Premier on J.P. Laurel Avenue, Agdao, Davao City, with four distance options: 42K, 21K, 10K and 5K.
Race weekend is deliberately timed the day before the opening of Kadayawan Festival, so runners can join Davao's biggest cultural celebration right after finishing.

Organizers (RunRio, Singlife, Kinetix Sports, SM Supermalls) are targeting 4,000–6,000 local and international participants for this debut leg, with roughly ₱1.2 million in cash prizes and a BYD Seagull raffle vehicle.
Davao City is described as well connected with direct domestic flights and international links via Manila, making travel relatively straightforward for visiting runners.
research_watchouts: As a brand-new event, there are no participant race reports, reviews, or community discussions yet about actual course conditions, heat, water stations, or organization on race day — all available coverage is pre-race promotional/news material.
Ahotu's event listing for this race explicitly notes 'No reviews yet,' confirming the lack of first-hand participant feedback at this time.

faqs.question: When is the Singlife Davao Marathon held?
faqs.answer: The Singlife Davao Marathon is scheduled to take place on August 15, 2026. It is held in Davao City, Philippines, with SM City Lanang serving as the event venue. Registration for this race is currently open for interested participants who wish to take part in one of its available distance categories.

faqs.question: What distances are offered at the Singlife Davao Marathon?
faqs.answer: The Singlife Davao Marathon offers four distance categories for participants to choose from: a full marathon of 42.195km, a half marathon of 21.1km, a 10km race, and a shorter 5km race. This range allows runners of different experience levels and training backgrounds to participate in the event.

faqs.question: Where does the race start or take place?
faqs.answer: The Singlife Davao Marathon takes place at SM City Lanang, located in Davao City, Philippines. This venue serves as the base for the event, which includes multiple race distances. The race is part of the broader lineup of marathon events happening in the Philippines in 2026.

faqs.question: Who organizes the Singlife Davao Marathon?
faqs.answer: The Singlife Davao Marathon is organized by RUNRIO Inc., a race organizing company responsible for coordinating the event's logistics, including registration and venue arrangements. The race is set to take place at SM City Lanang in Davao City, Philippines, on August 15, 2026, with registration currently open.
